post.title: How airlines make billions from credit cards
post.ig:
Airlines make a fortune from something that isn't a flight.

In 2025, American Express paid Delta $8.2B, up 11%. Delta's pre-tax profit that year: about $5B.
The bank buys miles to give cardholders, and earns swipe fees, annual fees and interest.
Delta is aiming for $10B a year.

Source: Delta full-year 2025 results (Jan 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
